verdict.rationale: Cognee is open-source and self-hostable, storing data in your own graph/vector/relational backends (docker run locally, cognee.start_ui() with no account required), which implies the underlying data is already under the user's control rather than locked in a proprietary silo. However, there is no documented explicit 'export' command or open-format export feature (e.g., JSON/GraphML dump) — the only data-movement CLI commands shown are 'push' (upload to Cognee Cloud) and 'report' (graph insight), not an export-and-leave path. Missing for 10: an explicit documented export/download command producing open-format output, and independent confirmation that self-hosted data can be freely extracted/migrated.
